meta.name: product-launch-video
meta.description: Turn a product or marketing URL, pasted script, or brief into a product launch / promo video — SaaS promos, feature reveals, product demos, app and company launches. Use when the user wants to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product; the default for any commercial URL. Site tours / showcases of a website route here too — the brief carries the show-it-as-is intent. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 输入产品链接或脚本文案,自动生成宣传视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你想把产品链接快速变成一支宣传视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn a product link or script into a promo video.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to turn your product page into a promo video.

howto.what: 装上后,当你想为产品或网站做宣传视频时,Claude 会走一整套流程:确认简报、抓取网页素材、定下视觉风格、写故事板和脚本,再一帧一帧做出画面并合成最终视频。它会根据你的 URL、脚本或简报来做。
howto.when: 当你想宣传、发布或推广某个产品,或给一个商业网站做导览展示时触发;给的是商业 URL 时默认走它。不清楚时转给 /hyperframes。

say.text: 帮我把这个 SaaS 产品页做成一个发布宣传视频。
say.note: Claude 会抓取该页面并生成故事板、脚本和成片。

say.text: 把这个新应用的营销文案做成产品演示视频。
say.note: 它会按简报规划画面和旁白,逐步渲染。

say.text: 给我的公司官网做一个介绍展示视频。
say.note: 站点会按原样截取作为视频画面素材。

howto.what_en: When you want a promo video for a product or website, Claude runs a full workflow: confirms the brief, captures the page, sets a visual style, writes storyboard/script, then builds frames and renders the final video from the URL, script, or brief.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product, or give a commercial website a tour/showcase; it is the default for any commercial URL. Unclear cases go to /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Turn this SaaS product page into a launch promo video.
say_en.note: Claude captures the page and produces storyboard, script, and final render.

say_en.text: Make a product demo video from this new app's marketing copy.
say_en.note: It plans visuals and voiceover from the brief, then renders step by step.

say_en.text: Create a showcase video of our company website.
say_en.note: The site is captured as-is to serve as the video's visuals.
